versions.changelog:
- Improved onboarding with a new "Start on APIDot" section for quick access to key APIDot URLs.
- No functional or API changes; skill remains documentation-only.
- Removed the file skill-card.md to streamline guidance.
- Clarified initial steps for ClawHub users integrating with APIDot Tripo P1 3D workflows.

- Added references/api.md with non-executable notes about Tripo P1 API workflows.
- Updated SKILL.md to reference the new documentation in references/api.md.
- Removed skill-card.md.
- Clarified the skill includes documentation-only files and local reference notes, with no executable content.

Initial documentation-only release for APIDot Tripo P1 3D API skill.

- Provides a comprehensive SKILL.md focused on Tripo P1 integration using APIDot APIs.
- Covers workflow for text-to-3D, image-to-3D, async task handling, and webhooks.
- Includes security guidelines for API key management and safe integration practices.
- Offers integration guidance, model routing, and links to official APIDot documentation and examples.
- No executable code, network actions, or credential storage included.
